cards.front: Recall a key point about Artists and Art Movements
cards.back: Your artist research should DIRECTLY inform your own work — do not just copy, respond and develop ideas.

cards.front: What should you know about fine art exam tips?
cards.back: Always include: artist NAME, artwork TITLE, DATE, MEDIUM. Analyse using FORMAL ELEMENTS language. Explain CONTEXT. Show your PERSONAL RESPONSE — not just copy, but develop. Make specific connections to your own work.

Students often make mistakes with this topic. Wrong: To show artist research, just copy their style in your own work. Correct: AQA requires you to DEVELOP ideas informed by sources — understand WHY an artist works that way and use their approach to inspire your OWN personal response. Slavish copying scores low on AO4 (personal response).

Research two artists from different movements. Write a critical analysis comparing their approaches, explaining their contexts, and showing how each has influenced the development of your personal project.

cards.front: Assessment Objective Focus: Artists and Art Movements
cards.back: AO1 — Knowledge: Demonstrate knowledge of Artists and Art Movements using appropriate art vocabulary. Identify techniques, materials and processes accurately.
